parsed.degree_signal: Master’s Degree in Computer Science, IT, Business Informatics or similar (or Bachelor's + ≥2yrs of full-time experience)
parsed.notes:
Only the 'Who you are' qualifications supply skills; repeated technologies in the company/project description do not independently establish requirements. No heading marks qualifications optional.
The experience fields and their illustrative technologies describe alternatives for one hands-on industry-experience ask, so mapped alternatives share group 1.
'Architecture' is read literally in its software/IT context as software architecture. Generic 'Web Development' is left unmapped rather than assuming full-stack development.
IT management and product ownership are treated as technical practices without matching taxonomy entries.
The highest degree named is master's. degree_or_equivalent is true because a bachelor's plus experience explicitly substitutes for the master's; flagged because the alternative still requires a degree.
German is not requested; the posting is in English.
